description: Fetch logs from multiple cloud platforms (AWS CloudWatch + Vercel) for a given time window and optional trace ID, then merge them into a single chronological timeline. Use this to correlate errors across frontend and backend services.

aws_log_group_prefix.description: CloudWatch log group prefix to search. Default: /aws/lambda

aws_region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_REGION env var.

cloudflare_worker.description: Cloudflare Worker script name to tail logs from.

end_time.description: End of time window (ISO-8601 string or Unix epoch in ms). Defaults to now.

gcp_service.description: GCP Cloud Run service name to filter logs. Omit to pull all project logs.

start_time.description: Start of time window (ISO-8601 string or Unix epoch in ms). Example: '2024-06-01T10:00:00Z'

trace_id.description: Trace / request ID to filter logs across platforms.

vercel_project.description: Vercel project name or ID to pull deployment logs from.

name: get_correlated_logs
